name: Offline 24W AI + GNU Radio 4D visualization rig

mentions.name: Offline 24W AI + GNU Radio 4D visualization rig
mentions.description: A portable, fully offline rig combining a GPD Win 5 handheld (112GB VRAM), the Agent-Zero agent framework, a Gwen3-Coder-Next-Q8_0 model, Unreal Engine 5, GNU Radio, and a b206mini SDR dongle. It decodes and encodes 4D visualizations with context understanding by capturing and generating data frames through GNU Radio self-iterating blocks, running entirely offline at only 24 watts, with cognitive radio applications and upcoming 6G AI protocols in mind.
mentions.source_excerpt: - Tinkering: gpd win 5 (112GB VRAM) + Agent-Zero + Gwen3-Coder-Next-Q8_0 + Unreal Engine 5 + gnuradio + b206mini = decode/encode 4D visualizations with context understanding by data frame captures/generation through gnuradio self-iterating blocks -- all running at only 24 watts (offline and portable).  Tons of cognitive radio applications, planning ahead for the new 6G AI protocols.
